title: Time Jump: 15:00 to 17:00 MDT, Coyote Draw Fire at 2,300 Acres

fields.scenarioTitle: One Road Out: PSPS, Evacuation Timing & Shared Zone Status
fields.narration: TIME JUMP. EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE. The exercise has run for 3 hours. We now move the clock forward two hours, from 15:00 to 17:00 MDT on the same day, Wednesday 14 April 2027. Since 16:15 the Coyote Draw Fire has been under Unified Command between the Colorado Division of Fire Prevention and Control and the Sheriff, working from the Pine Gulch EOC. The Incident Commander's summary as of 16:55 MDT: about 2,300 acres, 0 percent contained. The fire is running east-southeast toward Gulch Village and Kestrel Springs and spotting up to a mile ahead. Gulch Saddle station reads west-northwest 28 mph, gusting 47, with relative humidity at 8 percent. About 900 structures are threatened. Since 16:00 the Fire Chief, the co-op, CDOT and the school district have each sent out their own road lists, and those lists disagree. Starting now, the EOC publishes one Shared Road Status List every hour, and every partner uses it in place of its own. The first issue is the 17:00 list, and it is in front of you for confirmation.
worldState: Coyote Draw Fire, IC summary as of 16:55 MDT: about 2,300 acres (field estimate plus the 16:40 satellite hotspot pass), 0 percent containment, spotting up to 1 mile ahead, head running east-southeast toward PG-03 Gulch Village and Kestrel Springs.
Unified Command (DFPC and the Sheriff) has been in place since 16:15 at the Pine Gulch EOC. Acreage is the Incident Commander's figure and is always given with its time.
Weather at Gulch Saddle: west-northwest 28 mph, gusts 47 mph, relative humidity 8 percent.
Resources: Type 3 engine strike team ST-CO-4417 is on scene and 2 SEATs are cycling from Fort Collins-Loveland. The Type 1 helicopter is still unable to fill.
Structures threatened: about 900.
Circuits 6, 7, 11 and 12 have been de-energized for 9 hours. Foothills Electric Cooperative has set no restoration time.
Pine Gulch High School shelter: 212 registered. Mountain View Fairgrounds: 47 horses and 19 head of cattle.
SHARED ROAD STATUS LIST, 17:00 issue. Mill Creek Bridge at CR 68: the jackknifed horse trailer was cleared at 16:05. The status carries forward the decision the EOC recorded at 15:10.

SHARED ROAD STATUS LIST, 17:00 issue. Highway 305 canyon, if contraflow was ordered: CONTRAFLOW, outbound only, in place 25 minutes after the recorded go time. If shelter in place was ordered: CONTROLLED, one outbound lane, canyon residents sheltering in place, responders in.
SHARED ROAD STATUS LIST, 17:00 issue. Kestrel Springs Road: CONTROLLED at the KS-04 traffic control point (residents out, responders in).
SHARED ROAD STATUS LIST, 17:00 issue. CR 68 (Gulch Road): CLOSED east of Coyote Draw at the CR 68 traffic control point.
From this hour on, the fire districts, the co-op, CDOT, the school district and the hospital stop sending their own road lists and use the EOC's hourly list.
fields.facilitatorNote: Read only the Highway 305 line that matches what the players ordered at I-13 (contraflow or shelter in place). Fill in the Mill Creek Bridge status from their recorded decision. If they made no decision, read it as 'Controlled, pending EOC confirmation' and make them set it now. The EM should confirm the list with Public Works, CDOT and the Sheriff and send it on the hour.

instructorNote: This card resets the fire picture to 17:00 and forces one shared road list. Watch whether the EM confirms the 17:00 list with Public Works, CDOT and the Sheriff and sends it on the hour to CDOT, the fire districts, the school district and the co-op (SENTCS 5). Also watch whether the PIO gives acreage only as the Incident Commander's figure with its time, never as the county's own number (SENTCS 7).
